name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Senior Engineering Manager
summary: Hands-on engineering leader with 25+ years building and delivering software, including leading teams of 6-8 developers. I have deep expertise in distributed systems using C#/.NET and Java. Hosting in cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, and AI-assisted agent development. I've also built user-facing applications with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Blazor and Angular. I've dabbled in React and am constantly studying tools, tactics and strategies beyond my current work. I partner closely with product teams, coach engineers, and lead teams in shipping reliable software.

Technical Leadership & Architecture: Distributed Systems, SOA & Cloud-Native Systems Design
Modern SDLC, Quality & Operations: Modern CI/CD Toolchains: GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps & Bamboo
Automated Testing, Cucumber, BDD & Unit Testing
Code Review, SonarQube & Static Quality Practices
AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot, Instruction Files & MCP Integrations
